claims.question: q1
claims.claim: A semantic layer is a governed set of metric, dimension, and entity definitions that sits between the warehouse and every tool that queries it.
claims.quote: A semantic layer is a governed set of metric, dimension, and entity definitions that sits between your warehouse and every tool that queries it.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: A context layer is the business knowledge an AI agent reads before writing SQL or answering; it bundles semantic models, documentation, lineage, glossary terms, example queries, and unstructured knowledge and exposes them to agents, often over MCP.
claims.quote: A context layer is the business knowledge an AI agent reads before it writes SQL or answers a question. It usually bundles semantic models, model and column documentation, lineage, glossary terms, example queries, and unstructured knowledge from wikis and tickets, then exposes all of it to agents, often over MCP.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: In most stacks, the semantic layer is one input to the context layer.
claims.quote: In most stacks, the semantic layer is one input to the context layer.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: A Definition of Record is a plain-English, versioned, attributed statement of an agreed business-term meaning, published so people and AI agents use the same meaning.
claims.quote: A Definition of Record is a plain-English, versioned, attributed statement of what an organization has agreed a business term means, published so that people and AI agents use the same meaning.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Without governed definitions, an agent asked how many active vendors exist found three defensible answers: 25, 24, and 21, each traced to a tested model.
claims.quote: Asked “how many active vendors do we have?”, an agent reading a sample project found 25, 24, and 21. Each number traced to a tested model in that project.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: With a governed Definition of Record served over MCP, the same agent returned 25, cited its source column, and flagged an ERP field that disagreed with actual buying in 6 of 34 vendors.
claims.quote: With a governed Definition of Record served over MCP, the same agent returned 25, cited its source column, and flagged an ERP field that disagreed with actual buying in 6 of 34 vendors.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: A semantic layer will consistently compute whichever definition is encoded, even if that definition is the wrong business choice.
claims.quote: A semantic layer will compute whichever one you encode, consistently, forever.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: More context about an undecided term can make an agent more confidently wrong.
claims.quote: More context about an undecided term gives an agent more ways to be confidently wrong.
